title: Mousetrap
subtitle: When the nose catches the scent of the cheese, that's when the tail gives it away.

items.text: Night has deepened, and the little restaurant on the corner outside of Chinatown is almost empty. The doorbell chimes, and two people walk in.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Scott, and Tall Officer, over here.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Again, it's Poitier. Have you seriously already forgotten my name? It's only been three hours.
At Loggerhead's call, the two newcomers take a seat at her and Liáng's table.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: What's your status?

items.speaker: Scott
items.text: Couldn't find anything useful. Sorry.

items.speaker: Scott
items.text: I already asked the investigators who came with me to track down the other missing items, you know, to cover up for Loggerhead, but so far, they haven't found anything.

items.speaker: Scott
items.text: As for the person who stole the item, I haven't a clue.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Well ...

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: At least there haven't been any reports of arcane explosions or earthquakes. No news is good news, right?

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: What about you? Any leads?

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Ms. Noire didn't take the film, but she refused to tell us anything about its curse or the former owner, Hé Rìjūn.
She lets out a deliberately dejected sigh, withholding the final message Noire gave her.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Looks like I'm the only one who has good news.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: You do? What about?
Poitier tilts her head, gesturing past Scott to the darkened street outside the window.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: The illegal trade of arcane items. You told me to keep an eye on it.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: I contacted my guy who tracks all that stuff. Told me about this trader called Pug Dog, a middleman in the black market.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: He was pulled over for speeding this morning, but he actually paid the ticket right away. Can you believe that? I wouldn't be surprised if he shot the police car and ran away there.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: An outlaw suddenly behaving himself ...

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: He must be up to something important. Something big enough to make him avoid getting into trouble over a speeding ticket.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: The officers thought the same, so they tracked him to this stolen car, right? Well, guess where it's headed—here, Chinatown.
A man with a deep, jagged scar across his brow saunters under the moonlight.
At last, he stops, slipping into a darkened alleyway. He has no idea that four silent pursuers are lurking nearby, hidden under a rookie vigil's Silent Shadow arcane skill.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: What's he doing?

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Waiting for someone's my guess.

items.speaker: Scott
items.text: A middleman for the arcane black market. So, he probably has the cursed film, and now he's planning to sell it to someone.

items.speaker: Scott
items.text: We should get him now, before the film's sold off. Come on, this is our chance.

items.speaker: Scott
items.text: Hm? Mmm.
Liáng clamps a hand over her mouth just in time, muffling her outburst.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Shh. Someone's coming.
From the depths of the shadows, a figure emerges.
Not walking toward Pug Dog, but riding something. Perhaps—a wheelchair.

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: Good evening, sir. I hope I didn't keep you too long.

items.speaker: Pug Dog
items.text: You got the dough?

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: Of course.
Noire pulls a rectangular object from her coat.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: It's an envelope. Looks pretty thick.
Poitier is right. Pug Dog takes the envelope and pulls a handful of bills from it before nodding in satisfaction.

items.speaker: Pug Dog
items.text: All here. Dontcha worry, alright? You can trust me. Everyone in L.A. knows Pug Dog.
He stuffs the bulging envelope into his pocket before pulling an item from his jacket.

items.speaker: Pug Dog
items.text: Here's your stuff.
The item cuts an arc through the darkness, landing precisely in Noire's waiting hands.

items.speaker: Pug Dog
items.text: Heh. I like customers like you, generous and to the point. Alright, I'm outta here. Pleasure doin' business with ya. And hey, feel free to call me again.
He scans the area before turning back to Noire, lowering his voice.

items.speaker: Pug Dog
items.text: Seein' as you're a good customer o' mine, here's a bit of advice: Watch your back on the way outta here.

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: What do you mean?
But Noire doesn't get the chance to press further.
The moment has come. Liáng strides out from the shadows.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Sorry to interrupt, but neither one of you will be making your own way home. Ms. Noire, Pug Dog.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: I'm afraid you'll be coming to the Arcane Affairs office with me.

items.speaker: Pug Dog
items.text: F**kin' cop!

items.speaker: Pug Dog
items.text: Ow! Easy, easy.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Shut up and stay down!
Pug Dog's attempts to fight back have been utterly useless.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Ms. Noire, could you show me what he gave you?

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: Go ahead.
She hands a dusty gray box to Liáng.
Inside is an ordinary-looking film reel. But Liáng can feel the vessel containing Qiángliáng growing warm against her skin.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Super 8 mm. This must be it. Reunion of the Three Swallows. Hé Rìjūn's final work.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: The culprit behind the strange happenings in Chinatown.
Yet for now, it lies quietly in her grasp, docile and unthreatening.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Well, that was easier than expected. Half a day, and we've already tracked it down.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Now all we gotta do is stop it from doing its arcanum-y thing. But how? Smash it?
Before Liáng can respond, Noire voices a polite opposition.

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: I don't think that's a good idea.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: I have to admit, Ms. Noire's right.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Arcane items need to be handled with the utmost care. No one knows what will happen once it's broken. We could make things worse.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Fine. Let's take these two back to the office first.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: On your feet, tough guy! We gotta go.

items.speaker: Pug Dog
items.text: Ugh. Damn it. How'd ya find me? Some asshole sell me out?
Pug Dog is yanked up from the ground. He reluctantly follows Poitier, grumbling and cursing under his breath.
But as he passes Liáng, he stops.

items.speaker: Pug Dog
items.text: Wait. You!
He stares.
Not at her, precisely, but at the figure cowering behind her.

items.speaker: Pug Dog
items.text: It was you! You f**kin' traitor! I shoulda known you were workin' with the cops.
Loggerhead tilts her head in confusion.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

items.speaker: Scott
items.text: Uh, wait, let me explain. This is just a misunderstanding.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Don't worry, Ms. Scott. You're right. There has been a misunderstanding between you and him. Allow me to explain.
Scott heaves a sigh of relief, only for Liáng's next words to hit her like a thunderclap.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: You never had the intention of betraying him, nor were you working with us.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: You simply gave him the item you wanted to sell. That's it.
